claims: C1 the assistant should seek clarification when an instruction might be intended
C2 the duty to seek clarification applies when the instruction could cause serious side effects
C3 the duty is triggered by the conjunction of possible intent and serious side effects

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries root authority because it is in the #ignore_untrusted_data section

concepts.name: instruction_might_be_intended
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that might be intended by the user, even though it is not certain
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of instructions that 'might be intended', so a predicate for that possibility is needed

concepts.name: serious_side_effects
concepts.gloss: following instruction I could cause serious side effects
concepts.inference: the clause conditions the duty on instructions that 'could cause serious side effects', so a predicate for that risk is needed

concepts.name: clarification_for
concepts.gloss: C is a clarification the assistant seeks about instruction I
concepts.inference: seeking clarification is an act directed at the instruction in question, so a relation between the clarification and the instruction is needed

asserts.read_back: the assistant should seek clarification % about instruction % when % might be intended and could cause serious side effects

closure.reason: the clause obliges seeking clarification only when an instruction might be intended and could cause serious side effects; it does not address other clarifications, so silence permits them
